name: tabular-benchmark-797-classification
description: A large suite of 797 tabular classification datasets aggregated to benchmark machine learning algorithms on diverse structured data. The collection measures classifier performance across many domains, testing generalization and robustness of models and AutoML systems on tabular tasks. It is intended to serve as a broad, empirical testbed for comparing classification methods.
reputation: Used within the imodels ecosystem and by researchers needing a large, diverse set of tabular classification tasks; moderately recognized in the tabular ML community.
